The total cash price of the machinery was ₹9,00,000. A down payment of ₹1,00,000 was made immediately upon signing the contract. The balance was payable in four semi-annual instalments of ₹2,00,000 each, plus interest at 8% per annum on the outstanding balance. Jupiter Logistics paid the first and second instalments on their due dates but failed to pay the third instalment due on 30th June 2024. Consequently, on the same day , after negotiation, it was agreed that the purchaser would retain a portion of the machinery (original cash price ₹4,50,000), while the remaining portion was repossessed by the seller at an agreed value of ₹3,40,000. A new agreement was signed for the payment of the balance amount. Jupiter Logistics charges depreciation at 10% p.a. on the Written Down Value (WDV) basis. In the books of Jupiter Logistics prepare : The statement of interest calculations for all 2 years up to 31/12/2024 Machinery Account and Depreciation Account for the years ending 31/12/2023 and 31/12/2024 M/s Titan Engineering Works Account up to the date of re-possession.
